notes:
### New
- **Tracks added from a USB stick are copied to your computer.** Adding a
  stick's tracks to one of OpenCrate's own playlists now copies their audio
  into an import folder (Settings → General → Music from USB sticks; by
  default `OpenCrate` inside your Music folder) instead of pointing at the
  stick, which stopped working once it was unplugged. Music already on your
  computer is never copied or moved.
- **Import from stick into OpenCrate:** Sync → USB stick → Import from
  stick can now import into OpenCrate's own library, bringing the
  playlists and copying the audio of tracks only the stick has into your
  import folder.
- **Import from stick reads all of a stick's libraries at once.** OneLibrary,
  Device Library and Engine DJ are ticked together; the same song in several
  libraries counts once (songs are recognised by their audio, not their file
  names), playlists show which libraries have them, and a summary says how
  many songs are new, already in OpenCrate or already on your computer (those
  are used where they are, never copied). Songs that are on the stick more
  than once are listed as a warning.
- **OpenCrate keeps every library's cues, loops, beatgrids and track info
  for a song,** from Rekordbox, Engine DJ and each stick, and remembers where
  each came from. Choose which to use in Settings → General → Cues, grids and
  track info (Rekordbox's, Engine DJ's, or OpenCrate's own; the stick's or
  this computer's version). Nothing is ever thrown away or overwritten.
- **Choose which library's cues and grid a song uses.** Right-click a song
  in OpenCrate's own library → Cues & grid versions…: pick OpenCrate's own,
  Rekordbox's, Engine DJ's or a stick's version. Nothing is deleted.
- **See and batch-change which library's cues and grid are used.** A new
  Cues/Grid column in the track list shows RB, EDJ or OC for each song, and
  right-clicking several selected tracks (such as a whole playlist) → Cues &
  grid versions… lets you switch them all at once.
- **Merge duplicate songs.** Right-click → Merge duplicate songs… finds songs
  OpenCrate holds more than once and merges them into one: playlists and all
  versions are kept, audio files are never touched.
- **Stick libraries now show their cues, loops and beatgrids** (read from the
  stick's analysis files), not only their playlists.
- **A stick's two Rekordbox databases are listed separately,** as in
  Rekordbox: *OneLibrary* (newer players) and *Device Library* (older
  players), so you can tell what each will show. Import from stick lets you
  pick either.
- **Fixed:** a stick synced by Rekordbox 7 could show fewer tracks and
  older playlists in OpenCrate, because its newest changes sit in a side
  file OpenCrate didn't read.
